title: One vote on one tag, a line of data/assessments.jsonl (v0 draft)
$comment: Asks whether a tag is something job listings ask for: a skill, an ability, a certification or a language. Any number of people and models can vote on one tag. A tag listed in a legacy list also counts as one yes, worked out from the lists and not stored here. A vote backs no claim; it shows who thinks what and where they disagree.

tag.description: The tag as it is written in the legacy list.

key.description: The tag in lower case, spaces collapsed; what votes are grouped by.

question.description: Is this something job listings ask for? v0 has one question.

effort.description: The effort level the model ran at.

run.description: The run label. For a model it is in data/runs.json.

reason.description: Why, when the answer is no or unsure.

entry.description: The entry made from this tag, if the vote was yes and made one.

variant_of.description: The entry this tag was added to as a variant.

proposed_name.description: The entry name this voter proposed, when its entry is not in this repository.
